picker.bundle.title: Import a TunnelHop bundle
picker.servers.title: Add servers
file.not_bundle: {name} is not a bundle: TunnelHop bundles are .zip files
file.not_config: {name} cannot be added: servers come from .conf (WireGuard) and .ovpn (OpenVPN) files
file.bundle_too_large: {name} is larger than 20 MB, the most a bundle may be
file.config_too_large: {name} is larger than 1 MB, the most a config may be
file.read_failed: The files could not be read: {reason}
status.hint.unreachable: Start the TunnelHop service to connect.
status.hint.blocked: Traffic is blocked until a tunnel is up, or you unblock.
status.hint.disconnected: Not protected. Connect to pick a server.
status.hint.no_bundle: No bundle is in use. Switch to one below.
status.hint.empty: Add your VPN config files to get started.
bar.unreachable: The TunnelHop service is not running. The app reconnects to it on its own.
bar.switch.engaged: Switching to "{bundle}" disconnects the current tunnel and lifts the block first.
bar.switch.idle: "{bundle}" is installed, but not the bundle in use.
error.drop: Drop .conf and .ovpn files to add as servers, or one .zip of them.
error.import.no_service: The TunnelHop service is not running, so the bundle was not imported.
error.import.busy: The bundle was not imported: another request was still running. Drop it again.
error.servers.no_service: The TunnelHop service is not running, so the servers were not added.
error.servers.busy: The servers were not added: another request was still running. Drop them again.
confirm.block_stays: The block stays in place meanwhile.
confirm.leaves_tunnel: The current tunnel is disconnected and the block is lifted first.
confirm.remove.title: Remove "{name}"?
confirm.remove.moves: You are connected through it: TunnelHop moves to another server first.
confirm.remove.result: It is removed from "{bundle}" with its saved sign-in.
confirm.switch.title: Switch to "{bundle}"?
confirm.switch.unprotected: Traffic is not protected until you connect again.
confirm.delete.title: Delete "{bundle}"?
confirm.delete.result: Its servers and saved sign-in are removed from this PC. This cannot be undone.
servers.heading: Servers in {bundle}
bundles.heading: Bundles
bundles.list_failed: The installed bundles could not be listed.
bundles.empty: No servers yet. Add the .conf (WireGuard) or .ovpn (OpenVPN) files from your VPN provider, or drop them on this window. A .zip of them, or a prepared TunnelHop bundle, works too.
bundles.waiting: The installed bundles appear here once the service is running.
details.heading: Details
details.killswitch.on: On: traffic outside the tunnel is blocked
rotation.heading: Rotation
rotation.auto.hint: Hop to another server on a timer
rotation.interval.hint: How often to hop while auto-rotation is on
exit.hint: Disconnects, lifts the block, and closes the app. Closing the window keeps it in the tray.
drop.overlay: Drop config files to add as servers, or a .zip to import it
add.new_title_one: New bundle from a config file
add.hint: The name is what the server list shows. Each file is checked like an imported bundle; a file that could run a program is refused.
add.reconnects: The tunnel reconnects once; the block stays in place meanwhile.
signin.label: Sign in
signin.title: Sign in to {name}
signin.one_server: This server asks for a username and password. They apply to this server only.
signin.needed_one: One server needs a username and password from your VPN provider. They are used for every such server in this bundle.
signin.needed_other: {n} servers need a username and password from your VPN provider. They are used for every such server in this bundle.
signin.stored: Stored by the TunnelHop service, encrypted for this PC. The app keeps no copy.
runtime.unchecked: {name} could not be checked ({required} or newer is needed)
runtime.too_old: {name} {found} is too old ({required} or newer is needed)
help.unreadable: {name} is installed, but its version could not be read.
help.needs: TunnelHop needs {required} or newer for {protocol} servers. Install the current release over it.
help.missing: TunnelHop starts and controls {protocol} tunnels itself, and for that it needs {name} installed on this PC. It was not found.
help.connect.strong: OpenVPN Connect is a different program and cannot be used.
help.connect.rest: It is what openvpn.net and the Microsoft Store offer first. TunnelHop needs the Community edition (version 2.x), which can be installed next to it.
help.pick.openvpn: Choose the Windows 64-bit MSI installer; its file name starts with OpenVPN-2.
help.closes: TunnelHop notices the new program a few seconds after its installer finishes; this message then closes by itself.
